scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
scenarios.reasoning: The agent found the Distrib property for DataSources and identified the signing error, but failed on the core analytical questions. It concluded there was no output directory sharing — the opposite of the expected finding — and never explained the causal mechanism behind the signing failure. The agent gave up too easily when evaluations for other projects weren't directly available, rather than trying alternative search strategies to find their Distrib or output paths.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects
